verdicts.ACTIVE: Structural resemblance and news pulse are both at 60 or above.
verdicts.SIGNAL: News pulse is at 60 or above but the structure is below 60. Often noise.
verdicts.LATENT: Structural resemblance is 60 or above while the news stays quiet.
